thread:
marco (docs): Quick thread: updating region availability table for Brazil (sa-bz) and adding data residency callouts. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1317. Need legal/intl/platform eyes.

ida (intl): For Portuguese (pt-BR) translation, pls ensure we don't reuse 'residency' literal; localized phrasing should match legal. I'll queue translation once English copy final.

jorge (platform): Note: Hosted endpoints currently route via nearby regions for South America; we don't have a physical sa-bz cluster yet. Suggest wording: 'Hosted API accessible from South America with best-effort latency; data residency guarantees available via Dedicated/Private deployments in Brazil via partners.'

rachel (legal): Please include contract note: "Data residency guarantees in Brazil are provided only under specific contractual terms with customers and partners, and may require additional compliance checks." Can we pin that to the expanded legal caveat?

kyle (eng): Snippet update: current SDK shows `region: 'sa-bz'` in client constructor. Recommend we switch to explicit host example for Hosted vs header for Dedicated: ```js
// Hosted (no residency guarantee)\nconst client = new RedwoodClient({ baseURL: 'https://sa.api.redwood.ai', apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })\n// Dedicated/Private (residency header)\nconst clientDedicated = new RedwoodClient({ baseURL: 'https://api.redwood.ai', apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY, headers: { 'X-Region': 'sa-bz' } })\n```

marco (docs): Good. Rachel: can you paste the legal-approved sentence and any required phrase to avoid translation drift?

rachel (legal): Approved sentence for PR: "Hosted API is accessible to South American customers but does not include contractual data residency guarantees. Data residency guarantees are available through Dedicated or Private deployments under specific contractual arrangements."

ida (intl): I'll add pt-BR i18n note and schedule translation once merged. Also, small link fix: region page references 'sa-latam' in some table cells, should be 'sa-bz' for Brazil; I can patch that in the PR.

marco (docs): Plan: Marco updates PR with revised snippet, jorge confirms infra wording, rachel adds legal line, ida updates link name and adds i18n TODO. Target: merge before next week's doc sprint. Any blockers?

jorge (platform): No blockers. We'll coordinate with partners if a Brazil partner onboarding page needs to be public first.

marco (docs): Thanks team :handshake:
